blocks.text: PUCALLPA, Peru — Pope Leo XIV crossed Sunday from the high Andes to the Amazon, where he warned that environmental destruction was threatening both the rainforest and the people who depend on it. Hours after visiting the ancient Incan capital of Cusco, more than 3,400 meters (11,000 feet) above sea level, the 71-year-old pontiff arrived in the jungle, where he said “the cry of the earth and the cry of the poor are inseparable.” He demanded justice for Indigenous leaders killed defending their territories, telling missionaries and representatives of Amazonian peoples that “the blood of these brothers cries out to God […]...
